_comment: Every tunable number in the tracker. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are stripped before validation. Change a number, reload the site: history re-grades itself (all analytics run at view time).

valueAdjustments._comment: Multipliers applied to FantasyCalc values per league before any ranking or lineup maths.
valueAdjustments._tePremiumMultiplier: Applied to TE values in leagues where scoring_settings.bonus_rec_te > 0.
valueAdjustments._qbFourPointPassTdMultiplier: Applied to QB values when pass_td = 4 (FantasyCalc's superflex baseline assumes 6pt).
valueAdjustments._volumeBonusRbWrMultiplier: Boost for high-volume RB/WR in yardage-bonus leagues (Syndicate). Set to 1.0 to disable.
valueAdjustments._volumeBonusMinPositionRank: Volume bonus only applies to RB/WR at or better than this position rank (proxy for volume).

ageBands._comment: Boundaries for the age-weighted value split. Bands: <= youngMax | youngMax+1..primeMax | >= primeMax+1.
ageBands._defaultAge: Used when both the Sleeper dump and FantasyCalc lack an age.

direction._comment: Cutoffs for Contender / Ascending / Mushy middle / Rebuilding. Ranks are within-league, 1 = best.
direction._contenderWinNowShareMin: Share of roster value held by players older than ageBands.youngMax.
direction._contenderMinWinPct: Ignored in preseason snapshots (no records exist yet).
direction._rebuildingStarterRankMinFromBottom: Starter rank within this many places of last = rebuilding candidate.

archetypes._comment: Player archetype rules. Declining is checked first and overrides Win-now vet.
archetypes._decliningMinAgeByPosition: Position-specific age cliffs (STRATEGY.md): WR market reprices at ~28, RB at ~28 in the current era, QB ages slowest, TE holds value longest. Unknown positions use decliningMinAge.
archetypes._decliningTrend30Max: trend30Day must be below this for a player past the position's age cliff to count as Declining.
archetypes._redraftDominanceRatio: redraftValue must exceed dynasty value by this ratio (or vice versa) before it counts as a win-now or youth signal.

picks._comment: Pick capital valuation. Slot numbers are overallRank positions on the FantasyCalc curve for the league's variant.
picks._thirdSlot: The brief only prices 1sts and 2nds; 3rds/4ths get these deep slots so pick capital is not understated. Tune to taste.
picks._futureSeasonDiscount: Picks two seasons out discounted by this fraction.
picks._earlyStandingsCutoff: Owing team in the TOP earlyStandingsCutoff of the standings (rank 1 = best) owes a LATE 1st; at or below lateStandingsCutoff owes an EARLY 1st; in between = mid. Preseason (no standings): all 1sts = mid.

verdicts._sellDuplicateDepthMinCount: Nth-or-worse player at a position, outside my optimal lineup, gets a sell look as duplicated depth. Never applies to youth assets (bench time is irrelevant to a young asset's value) or to excluded positions.
verdicts._duplicateDepthMinValue: Duplicated depth below this adjusted value is not worth a trade thread; it stays Hold.
verdicts._depthSellExcludePositions: Positions never sold as duplicate depth. Backup QBs in superflex are lottery tickets that appreciate the moment they get a start.
verdicts._contenderYouthConsolidateMinValue: On a contender, a non-starting youth asset above this adjusted value is flagged to consolidate (up-tier into a starter). Below it, cheap stashes are held. Never fires while the 30-day trend is negative (no selling the dip).
verdicts._minMarginalStarterValue: A buy target must add at least this much to my optimal lineup, else it is bench depth.

refresh._comment: Fetch behaviour for scripts/refresh.ts and the live-fetch button.
refresh._fcJoinRateWarnBelow: Warn if fewer than this fraction of rostered QB/RB/WR/TE match a FantasyCalc entry.
